Messages.Author: kushiel
Messages.Body:
When a player is discarding to gain the +x strength effect from
Death of My Conscience, does she discard the cards one at a time
or as a lot? In other words, can I discard one, see what I draw
to replace it, discard another, see what I draw to replace it,
etc. up to four times, or do I just pick up to four cards
currently in my hand? Thanks.

Kushiel

Messages.Author: Jesper
Messages.Body:
Unless something have changed here, you get a hand size X smaller for the
combat, which means you dont replace untill after the combat, since your
hand size are minus x.

Cheers
/Jesper

Messages.Body:


Correct. The cards are not replaced, so it is the same thing
discarding them all at once as one at a time.

Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:
thisi_s...@yahoo.com (kushiel) wrote in message news:<6f98ce2a.03100...@posting.google.com>...


You can discard them one at a time or in a lot. It doesn't matter
because you aren't replacing them until after the combat is over.

Card text:

"Requires a vampire with a capacity above 5. Do not replace this card
until after combat. Play before strikes are chosen.
[pot] Burn up to 4 cards in your hand. For each card you burn this
way, this vampire gets +1 strength for the remainder of combat. Do not
replace these cards until after combat.
[POT] As above, but this vampire gets +2 strength for the remainder of
combat for each card you burn this way."

-John Flournoy
